public_rationale: This is a checkable numerical claim, but the retrieved pages do not establish the weights when it was written. Nasdaq's readable pages expose later index levels, while the available third-party tables are later or lack a usable historical timestamp. Those differences cannot fairly contradict an earlier snapshot. None of the three percentages is verified.
limitations: No later-date percentage was treated as counterevidence.
Raw market-cap shares and ETF weights were not assumed to equal official index weights.
The unknown drafting time could matter for small discrepancies.

Test all three percentages against one consistent timestamp. Round NVIDIA's weight to two decimal places and the combined weights to one decimal place.

Treat '3000-company' as an approximate description of the Composite, not a separate exact constituent-count claim.
